scope: Small representative saved-input parity fixtures, not a performance experiment.

oracle_semantics.old_logq_logq_ols: Fitted joint OLS against intercept and true logqF/logqM
oracle_semantics.small_alpha_known_q_OLS: Fitted joint OLS; MUST NOT be used as oracle for default known_loading method
oracle_semantics.small_alpha_known_loading: Independent subtraction oracle; no archived .01 offset assumed

signature_offsets: Fixtures retain fixed Bill centering offsets. Saved correlation arrays omit these constants, which does not change Pearson or intercept-containing OLS correlations.
availability: Full bulk score availability is distinct from finite-source pure-target availability; both recorded. No row dropping in archived parity comparisons.
